dedupe_keys.name: nasjonalt register over luftfartshindre nrl norway s register of masts towers cranes and power lines that obstruct aviation

description: The national register of aviation obstacles holds the position and properties of man-made objects that stick up from the terrain, such as masts, towers, cranes and power lines, reported under the Norwegian regulation on reporting, registering and marking aviation obstacles. Contents: vector points, lines and polygons; the OpenStreetMap wiki notes the data include mobile and broadcast towers with lighting and heights, and that structures above 15 m in rural areas and 30 m in urban areas must be reported. Producer: Kartverket. Coverage: Norway. Format and access: distributed through Geonorge as FGDB, GML and PostGIS, maintained daily, last updated 27 September 2026 in the catalogue entry. Licence: the Norge digitalt licence, with access limited (Norge digitalt begrenset): the entry says the register is meant for aviation and only entitled parties get access, who should contact Kartverket. Caveats: the catalogue states the data are incomplete and must not be used for flight planning, and obstacles under 15 m registered after 3 July 2025 are excluded from the downloadable data; the wiki records a 2014 permission under which an earlier copy was published on OpenStreetMap under CC BY 4.0. Simulation uses: locating tall structures such as communication masts for telecom coverage and low-altitude flight or drone hazard studies. Related records: none identified.
